## F-Droid packaging compatibility

- The release APK omits the encrypted dependency metadata block that the Android Gradle Plugin normally adds during packaging. F-Droid's APK scanner rejected that block in v1.3.16.
- The APK still uses the existing LibRedirect Mobile signing certificate, so you can install it as an update to v1.3.16. The app uses the same dependencies and permissions.

## Android compatibility and downloads

- Android 8.0 (API 26) is the minimum supported version. The app targets Android 17 (API 37) and builds with Android SDK Platform 37.2.
- GitHub CI runs connected device tests on API 28, 36, 37.0, and 37.2. The API 37.2 emulator uses 16 KB memory pages.
- Download the signed APK and its SHA-256 checksum from the release assets. Obtainium can track updates from this GitHub repository.
- Android version code is 26.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/sametcn99/libredirect-mobile/compare/v1.3.16...v1.3.17)
